# std/div

> / : integer division, rounding toward zero (like C)

truck [std](../std.md) · [source](../../../registry/std/div.pkg) · translated by [bintables/div](../bintables/div.md) · translated by [ctables/div](../ctables/div.md) · translated by [webtables/div](../webtables/div.md)

Integer division, rounding toward zero (like C). Dividing by zero crashes the program.

```
print 7 / 2     // 3
print -7 / 2    // -3
```

Infix, precedence 60, left-associative. Both operands must be `int`; the
result is `int`.

## Syntax

Kind: `infix`, precedence 60, left-associative

```
{left: expr int} / {right: expr int} -> int
```

| slot | takes | type |
|---|---|---|
| `left` | expression | `int` |
| `right` | expression | `int` |

Produces: `int`
